purpose: Keep raw run evidence, replay evidence, controller progress, and derived dashboard analytics separate and joinable.

layers.role: step-level screenshot and bounded provider-event evidence

forbidden_persistence: API keys, passwords, cookies, authorization headers, or access tokens
raw prompts, raw provider replies, or literal typed values
hidden oracle/database state in visual or hybrid observations
analysis_rules: Controller progress rows without a valid visual, hybrid, or playwright run-record arm are excluded from run statistics.
Unknown and not-scored truth remain in denominators but are never counted as verdict-correct.
Complete matched blocks require all three arm labels under the same application, workflow, condition, and randomization block.
Derived snapshots are descriptive and never promote pilot records to confirmatory evidence.
